parts.text: Edit this image: change the diamond skull mask expression so he is YELLING in anger: the skull jaw dropped wide open with rows of diamond-studded teeth showing, the brow ridge pulled down hard into a furious angry scowl over the dark eye sockets, an aggressive shouting expression (not a long screaming oval mouth). Keep it a sparkling diamond-encrusted skull. Keep the black hooded cloak, bloody chrome knife, glowing flip phone, blood moon woods background, pose and clay style exactly the same.
